overview: An Irish fisherman discovers a woman in his fishing net believing her to be a mermaid.
tagline: The truth is not what you know. It's what you believe.

recs.blurb: Two teenage girls discover that mermaids really do exist after a violent storm washes one ashore. The mermaid, a sassy creature named Aquamarine, is determined…
A successful businessman falls in love with the girl of his dreams. There's one big complication though; he's fallen hook, line and sinker for a mermaid.
A woman risks losing her chance of happiness with the only man she has ever loved.
A holiday fable that tells the story of an elderly man discovering love for the first time.
An experiment on a simpleton turns him into a genius. When he discovers what has been done to him he struggles with whether or not what was done to his was…
With John's social life at a standstill and his ex-wife about to get remarried, a down on his luck divorcée finally meets the woman of his dreams, only to…
Adapted from a story by William Irish, it's a noirish tale of a man who orders a mail-order bride but receives instead a con woman.
Elvis Prestley's first film is a Civil War drama.
A lighthearted story about a man and a woman who seem destined to be together... and the hilarious chain of accidents that seem determined to keep them apart!
After discovering her boyfriend is married, Carly soon meets the wife he's been cheating on. And when yet another affair is discovered, all three women team up…
Two top CIA operatives wage an epic battle against one another after they discover they are dating the same woman.
A career woman reassesses her parents' lives after she is forced to care for her cancer-stricken mother.
